messages:
Maya Chen: Hey team — nightly bring-up for galen-3b-quant8 flagged a large class of failures in the tool/function-calling evals. Most failing tests show the `result.steps` field as a single escaped multiline string instead of an array. Posting a trimmed sample from the artifacts.

EvalBot: nightly-eval #432: job failed (schema mismatch) — 37/120 toolcall tests failed. See /artifacts/nightly/432/quant8/ for payloads.

Maya Chen: example payload (from artifact):
```json
{
  "tool_name": "workflow_runner",
  "result": {
    "steps": "[{\"op\":\"click\",\"x\":10,\"y\":20},{\"op\":\"type\",\"text\":\"hello\nworld\"}]",
    "status": "ok"
  }
}
```
validator output: 
```
SchemaError: expected array at result.steps but found string
  at validate(schema.py:42)
  at run_eval(eval_runner.py:210)
```

Samir Patel: is this unique to quantized model? did fp16 or hosted path pass?

Maya Chen: FP16 (galen-3b-fp16) and hosted-v1 passed the same prompt set with no stringification. The failures only show up on redwood/galen-3b-quant8 and a few 4-bit variants. Repro steps below.

Maya Chen: repro prompt (trimmed):
```
System: You are a tool integrator. When asked to CALL a tool, respond ONLY with a JSON object.
User: CALL TOOL: workflow_runner({"task":"onboard", "items":["a","b"]})
Expected: {"tool_name":"workflow_runner","result":{"steps":[{"op":"..."}]}}
```
Model config used: redwood/galen-3b-quant8, temp=0.0, top_p=0.95, max_tokens=200, stop token `

Chris Ortega: interesting — looks like the model is emitting the JSON but wrapping it in a string (adds outer quotes and escapes inner quotes/newlines). Could be a tokenization/quantization artifact where the model prefers to output a quoted literal.

Chris Ortega: quick check: does the raw token stream include the leading `"`? If yes, then we can patch the eval harness to attempt an automatic unwrapping pass (detect string containing leading `[` or `{` after unescaping) and json.loads it as a fallback. But we should be careful — that can hide other classes of issues.

Samir Patel: I ran a quick reproducer locally (using the same prompt + model). Raw text output: `"[{\"op\":\"click\",...}]"` i.e. the outer quotes are present. So model literally returned a quoted JSON string.

Jun Park: two potential root causes: (1) decoding/tokenizer changes in quantized variant that bias toward quote tokens; (2) decoding/truncation heuristics where the model switches to "verbatim string" mode for multi-line JSON. We've seen similar with sequences containing `\\n` before but not at this scale.

Maya Chen: immediate mitigation options: 
- add a lenient parsing step in nightly harness: try json.loads on field if type mismatch and the string starts with `[` or `{` after unescaping; flag as "auto-unwrapped" in report.
- add a canary test to detect quoted-json regressions and fail fast.
- for production rollout, block quant-8bit as a model variant for tool-calling routes until we fix.

Chris Ortega: agree. For the harness change we should: attempt 3 strategies (1) raw json.loads on field, (2) unescape common sequences `\\n`, `\\t`, `\"` then json.loads, (3) if still fails, attempt heuristic strip of leading/trailing quotes. All attempts should be logged and not silently accepted without a warning.

Samir Patel: I'll open a GH issue with reproducer and logs (will include raw tokens, detokenized text, and the failing payload). Assign to eng-ml/quant for root-cause.

Jun Park: I'll add a short canary to nightly to detect this class of failure (quoted-json in tool output) and set it to report-to #eng-ml with the artifact link.

Maya Chen: action items: @Samir run deeper detokenization + diff against fp16; @Chris add a safe-unwrap parser to the nightly harness and emit a `parsing_strategy` field in the eval result; @Jun add canary + alerting. I'll draft a short blurb for the onboarding notes blocking quant8 until we confirm behavior.

Samir Patel: starting reproducer now, ETA ~2h, will paste raw token ids and model logits slice if useful.

Chris Ortega: i'll PR the harness change as a toggle behind an env var so we can roll it out to nightly only.

Maya Chen: thanks. if anyone sees other patterns in artifacts (escaped CSVs, triple-quoted blocks, etc.), drop them here. :mag: :eyes:

EvalBot: note added to job 432: "auto-unwrapped" rubric not enabled — failures recorded.

Jun Park: logging note — please include `model_variant` and `quant_bits` in artifact metadata. That will make triage easier.

Maya Chen: ack. closing loop once Samir posts reproducer and Chris opens the PR.

Samir Patel: reproducible snippet posted: /artifacts/nightly/432/quant8/repro.txt (contains prompt, raw tokens, output).

Chris Ortega: PR opened: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/987 — harness opt-in parser + metrics.

Maya Chen: great, thanks all. We'll reconvene if root cause points to tokenization changes — might need model-side rollback or tokenization patch.
